ui.title: Between Us · 在我們之間
ui.subtitle: A couples conversation card deck: 700 questions, 7 themes. Draw, flip, talk.
ui.card_back_hint: Tap to flip back to question
ui.timer_prompt: Five minutes for each other. One speaks, one listens.
ui.back_quote: Speak slowly, listen gently. There are no right answers.
ui.keyboard_hint: Space: Flip | →: Next | F: Favorite | T: Timer
ui.mobile_hint: Tap: Flip | Swipe: Next | Tap icon: Favorite
ui.deck_empty: No questions in this category yet.
ui.load_from_drawer: Pick a question from the drawer to load
ui.commitment_text: "Between Us" is dedicated to creating an intimate conversation sanctuary. We collect zero personal data, use no ad tracking, and require no account. All bookmarks and settings stay entirely on your device.
ui.terms_text: All 700 conversation prompts and visual designs are protected by copyright for personal, non-commercial use between partners.
